title: Could next-gen artificial intelligence help map out future space outposts?
description: Planning a successful trip can be challenging, especially when your destination is in outer space. Even before liftoff, space missions require extraordinary amounts of scientific preparation and data analysis to succeed, which can take years to complete. However, as space agencies race to establish a permanent presence on the moon, using artificial intelligence to combine such information into a single system could make mission planning much more efficient.

title: FTC orders Walmart, Delta and others to share how they use personal data to set prices and pay
description: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission is ordering Delta Air Lines, Walmart and other companies to provide detailed information on how they use consumers’ data when they are setting prices. The commission said Wednesday it is also studying how ride-sharing and delivery companies like Uber use their independent drivers’ personal data when they are setting compensation rates. Orders were also issued to United, JetBlue, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart and Target. The FTC’s actions reflect customers’ increasing concerns about pricing technology and the use of artificial intelligence to collect vast amounts of data. Delta and JetBlue said Wednesday that they don't use personal data to set individualized prices.
